title: jacobaea erucifolia subsp. argunensis
intro: Jacobaea erucifolia subsp. argunensis, commonly known as Argun Ragwort, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which make it effective in relieving pain and reducing inflammation. Bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
